_comment: Every entry needs a reason. The audit also reports an exemption that has
gone stale, i.e. state that is now read after all, or no longer written.

intentionally_unread.doc_sections: list_doc_sections' actual return value; recorded because the tool returns it, not because anything gates on it
intentionally_unread.docs_listed: bookkeeping; search_docs works whether or not you listed sections first, so gating on it would invent a rule Rikyu does not have
intentionally_unread.docs_grounded: bookkeeping; the scheduler accepts a JobSpec written without reading the guide, so this must not become a gate
intentionally_unread.max_wall_time: the raw Slurm duration string get_facility returns; every precondition compares the parsed max_wall_time_hours instead
intentionally_unread.server_1_ready: server 1 is the HTN planner running this domain, so no action can meaningfully gate on it
intentionally_unread.rikyu_session_initialized: summary of the per-server flags, which are the real gates; kept for state dumps
